# BetSorted

> Independent South African sports betting comparison site. We review licensed
> SA bookmakers, compare odds and welcome bonuses, and publish free betting
> calculators. All operators listed hold a South African provincial licence.
> Content is written for South African punters and prices are in ZAR.

Editorial note: BetSorted earns affiliate commission on some outbound operator
links. Rankings are based on published terms, payout speed, market depth and
FICA requirements, not commission rates. See /editorial-policy.html.

## Start here

- [Best betting sites in South Africa](https://betsorted.co.za/best-betting-sites-south-africa.html): Every licensed SA bookmaker ranked on deposits, withdrawals, FICA and sports coverage.
- [Best betting apps](https://betsorted.co.za/best-betting-apps.html): SA betting apps tested and ranked, including data-free options.
- [Bookmaker reviews](https://betsorted.co.za/bookmakers/): Full reviews of each licensed South African bookmaker.
- [Betting bonuses](https://betsorted.co.za/betting-bonuses-south-africa.html): Welcome offers and free bets with the wagering terms spelled out.
- [Odds comparison](https://betsorted.co.za/odds-comparison.html): Side-by-side odds across SA bookmakers.

## Free calculators

- [Betting calculator](https://betsorted.co.za/betting-calculator.html): Odds conversion and returns.
- [Accumulator calculator](https://betsorted.co.za/accumulator-calculator.html): Combined odds on multi-leg tickets.
- [Value bet calculator](https://betsorted.co.za/value-bet-calculator.html): Expected value on a price.
- [Arbitrage calculator](https://betsorted.co.za/arbitrage-calculator.html): Stake split across outcomes.
- [Kelly criterion calculator](https://betsorted.co.za/kelly-criterion-calculator.html): Stake sizing.
- [Each way calculator](https://betsorted.co.za/each-way-calculator.html): Horse racing each-way returns.
- [Free bet calculator](https://betsorted.co.za/free-bet-calculator.html): True value of a free bet.
- [System bet calculator](https://betsorted.co.za/system-bet-calculator.html): Trixie, Yankee, Lucky 15 and similar.
- [Bonus value calculator](https://betsorted.co.za/bonus-value-calculator.html): What a welcome bonus is actually worth after wagering.
- [All calculators](https://betsorted.co.za/calculators.html)
